title: stisseria marmorata
intro: Stisseria marmorata, commonly known as the leopard's bane, is a plant species in the Convolvulaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Stisseria marmorata include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-hyperglycemic, and neuroprotective effects. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases, due to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing.
